annotations.title: Change settings, or end / reopen voting

description: Change settings, or end / reopen voting Needs the organizer key.

approve.description: Boards and nominations (while suggesting): new posts wait for approval.

categories.description: Contests: award categories. Names (new) or {id, name} (keeps that category's votes when renaming). A category with votes can't be removed.

closed.description: true ends voting now; false reopens it

criteria.description: Contests: what judges score, 1–10 each. Empty turns judging off.

labels.description: Ideas: categories, names (new) or {id, name} (renames). A category with posts can't be removed.

lang.description: The voters' language: the contest's QR codes and links open in it (anyone can switch). Defaults to en.

names.description: Boards and nominations (while suggesting): people may add their name.

replyAs.description: Ideas: how replies are signed, e.g. The library team.

slug.description: The id in the public link, e.g. `scarecrow-contest-2026-ab12` from https://qrvote.org/c/scarecrow-contest-2026-ab12

suggestUntil.description: Nominations, while suggesting: when suggestions close by themselves (Unix ms, before closesAt), or null to close them by hand.

theme.description: classic, halloween, harvest, winter, garden, carnival, beach, sports, hearts, stars, lunar, diwali, muertos, hanami, cats, dogs, campfire, art, trivia, classroom, cookoff, science, wedding, carshow, workplace, thanksgiving, or custom:<accent hex>-<second hex> (e.g. custom:1a73e8-ff8a5b)

name: update_settings
title: Change settings, or end / reopen voting
